metadataRaw.title: Instantly Relieve One-Sided Hip Pain #Shorts

Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve one-sided hip pain by targeting key muscles like the glutes and piriformis.

This simple seated exercise can be done at home or work and may provide relief in just 30 SECONDS.

Watch now to quickly relieve one-sided hip pain!
